problem_plain: Repsol needed to improve employee productivity and efficiency through automation of routine business tasks including meeting management, content generation, and document analysis.
capability: Copilot for Microsoft 365 deployment, including meeting recaps with automated extraction of tasks and deadlines, Word-to-PowerPoint content generation, and RFP analysis and authoring.
scale_outcomes: 550-employee pilot; four months; average time savings of 121 minutes per employee per week
reusable: Copilot for Microsoft 365 enterprise-wide deployment methodology; integrated adoption programme including demos, hands-on training, gamification and Community of Practice; measurement framework across efficiency, quality and employee experience.
summary: Repsol deployed Copilot for Microsoft 365 organisation-wide with support from Veridane and Microsoft, using a 550-employee pilot programme over four months with structured adoption activities. The deployment achieved average time savings of 121 minutes per employee per week as published in MIT Technology Review.
